symptoms.symptom: Moisture forms on outside of cabinet

causes.label: Not unusual during periods of high humidity.
remedies: Wipe surface dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Not unusual during periods of high humidity."

causes.label: Lid may not be seating properly, causing cold air from inside the freezer to meet warm moist air from the outside.
remedies: See Preparing to install the freezer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Lid may not be seating properly, causing cold air from inside the freezer to meet warm moist air from the outside."

causes.label: No power at outlet.
remedies: Replace fuse or reset the breaker.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "No power at outlet."

causes.label: Freezer is unplugged.
remedies: Push the plug completely into the outlet.

symptoms.symptom: Lid won’t fully close by itself

causes.label: Package holding lid open.
remedies: Move package to a different location.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Package holding lid open."

symptoms.symptom: Slow starting time after being off

causes.label: Built-in overload protection.
remedies: This is normal after being off.

causes.label: Lid left open.
remedies: Check to see if package is holding lid open.

causes.label: Too frequent or too long lid openings.
remedies: Open the lid less often.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Too frequent or too long lid openings."

causes.label: Not unusual during periods of high humidity.
remedies: Wipe surface dry.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Not unusual during periods of high humidity."

symptoms.symptom: Freezer external surface temperature is warm

causes.label: The external freezer walls can be as much as 30°F warmer than room temperature.
remedies: This is normal while the compressor works to transfer heat from inside the freezer cabinet.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "The external freezer walls can be as much as 30°F warmer than room temperature."

symptoms.symptom: Louder sound levels whenever freezer is on

causes.label: Modern freezers have increased storage capacity and more stable temperatures. They require a highefficiency compressor.
remedies: This is normal.
When the surrounding noise level is low, you might hear the compressor running while it cools the interior.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Modern freezers have increased storage capacity and more stable temperatures. They require a highefficiency compressor."

symptoms.symptom: Higher sound levels when compressor comes on

causes.label: Freezer operates at higher pressures during the start of the ON cycle.
remedies: This is normal.
Sound will level off or disappear as freezer continues to run.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Freezer operates at higher pressures during the start of the ON cycle."

symptoms.symptom: Popping or cracking sound when compressor comes on

causes.label: Metal parts undergo expansion and contraction, as in hot water pipes.
remedies: This is normal.
Sound will level off or disappear as freezer continues to run.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Metal parts undergo expansion and contraction, as in hot water pipes."

symptoms.symptom: Bubbling or gurgling sound, like boiling water

causes.label: Refrigerant (used to cool freezer) is circulating throughout the system.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Refrigerant (used to cool freezer) is circulating throughout the system."

symptoms.symptom: Moisture forms on inside freezer walls

causes.label: Weather is hot and humid, which increases internal rate of frost buildup.
remedies: This is normal.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Weather is hot and humid, which increases internal rate of frost buildup."

causes.label: Lid may not be seating properly.
remedies: See Preparing to install the freezer.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Lid may not be seating properly."

causes.label: Lid is kept open too long, or is opened too frequently.
remedies: Open the lid less often.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Lid is kept open too long, or is opened too frequently."

causes.label: Interior needs to be cleaned.
remedies: Clean interior with sponge, warm water and baking soda.
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Interior needs to be cleaned."

causes.label: Foods with strong odors are in the freezer.
remedies: Cover the food tightly. 49-60760-2
causes.evidence: GE manual, page 12: "Foods with strong odors are in the freezer."
